description: §18.2 — `|` arm-pattern alternation in value-form `match` arms: enum variants (`.Small | .Medium :>`), string literals (`"yes" | "y" | "ok" :>`) and numbers (`1 | 2 | 3 :>`). Each alternate takes its own value: #k "compact compact big big", #c "Y Y Y N ?", #t "low low mid mid high".
rationale: §18.2: "An arm pattern MAY list several alternates separated by `|` (`.B | .C :> r`, `"a" | "b" :> r`, `1 | 2 :> r` — the §51.0.J `derived=match` form), at ANY arm position." The alternates of one arm cover the union of their cases (§18.8.1: the enum match is exhaustive with no `else`).
